svg.title: CS231n 2025 Lecture Notes
svg.desc: A banner in three panels. The words CS231n are rendered as a coarse grid of coloured pixels: in the left panel they are buried in noise, in the middle panel partly visible, and in the right panel fully legible. Arrows run left to right, and the cumulative alpha of the diffusion schedule used for each panel is printed beneath it.
svg.text: Deep Learning for Computer Vision — written from the Spring 2025 lectures
Every diagram in these notes is drawn by a script committed beside it. This one included.
